name: Survey tile in Aries
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.7 degrees north of the ecliptic in Aries, imaged by SPHEREx 18 times in 6 visits over 62 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 31 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.6 days starting 2025-08-11, at wavelengths from 0.80 to 4.39 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
